Abstract
This paper describes a deterministic technical visualization pipeline with source-backed evidence, strong provenance, and clear extraction rules for release-quality generated images.

1 Introduction
PDF papers often contain the only useful source material for an infographic workflow. The gatherer needs readable text, headings, page boundaries, and conservative warnings.
